OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her legend shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never as armor, regalia or a costume. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

ERA: a present-day place where the Three Kingdoms is remembered — a museum of Han relics, a restored plank road, the Red Cliffs park, an old city wall, a Chengdu teahouse, the Wuhou Shrine, a Guan Yu temple, Baidicheng, the Changban Bridge, a film set, an opera dressing room, a calligraphy class or a festival street.

Outfit: a deep-coloured velvet bralette and high-waisted bottoms — in rich jewel tones such as emerald, sapphire, amethyst or wine red; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters away from the camera; head turned back over her own left shoulder — the shoulder on the image's left side; camera at her eye level.

Her eyes are naturally open and clear, not heavy-lidded or half-closed; brows relaxed and even, neither raised on one side nor furrowed; lips softly closed or only just parted.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing; nothing slipped off; intimate areas covered

Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her Three Kingdoms identity belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her faction's palette, armor, robes or regalia.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. LOOK-BACK: her back is toward the camera and her head turns at most a quarter turn over one shoulder — the face shows in profile or three-quarter view, never full-front on a back-facing torso. Her chin sits just above the near shoulder, the far eye and cheek may be partly hidden, the side of the neck shows the turn and the shoulder line continues behind the head. ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her. No logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.

AVOID: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.

observations: Rear three-quarter temple view with magnifying glass in right hand and left arm naturally lowered.
Identity compared against the selected world image; no detached or duplicated limbs observed.
